The affix घ comes after the words 1. अपोनप्तृ and 2. अपन्नप्तृ in the sense of 'that its deity'.

Terms: घ

In the यजुर्वेद , the short अ is retained after आपो , जुषनो , वृष्णो , वर्षिष्ठे and also in and after अम्बे or अम्बाले when they stand before अम्बिके।

Terms: संहितायाम्

Optionally the feminine अङ्ग (stem) in आ is not shortened before the affix कप्।

Terms: Shortening

त् is substituted for the final of the अङ्ग (stem) अप् before a case-ending beginning with भ्।

Terms: त् substitution
